mil7.4.8:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, suriyassa satta angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni satta angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.4.8:1.2: Yathā mahārāja suriyo sabbaṃ udakaṃ parisoseti,
mil7.4.8:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sabbe kilesā anavasesaṃ parisosetabbā.
mil7.4.8:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja suriyassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.8:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja suriyo tamandhakāraṃ vidhamati,
mil7.4.8:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sabbaṃ rāgatamaṃ dosatamaṃ mohatamaṃ mānatamaṃ diṭṭhitamaṃ kilesatamaṃ sabbaṃ duccaritatamaṃ vidhamayitabbaṃ.
mil7.4.8:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja suriyassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.8:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja suriyo abhikkhaṇaṃ carati,
mil7.4.8:3.2: evameva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena abhikkhaṇaṃ yoniso manasikāro kātabbo.
mil7.4.8:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja suriyassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.8:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja suriyo raṃsimālī,
mil7.4.8:4.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ārammaṇamālinā bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.4.8:4.3: Idaṃ mahārāja suriyassa catutthaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.8:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja suriyo mahājanakāyaṃ santāpento carati,
mil7.4.8:5.2: evameva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ācāra-sīla-guṇavattapaṭipattiyā jhāna-vimokha-samādhi-samāpatti-indriyabala-bojjhanga-satipaṭṭhāna-sammappadhāna-iddhipādehi sadevako loko santāpayitabbo.
mil7.4.8:5.3: Idaṃ mahārāja suriyassa pañcamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.8:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja suriyo Rāhubhayā bhīto carati,
mil7.4.8:6.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena duccarita-duggati-visamakantāravipāka-vinipāta-kilesajālajaṭite diṭṭhisanghāṭapaṭimukke kupathapakkhanne kummaggapaṭipanne satte disvā mahatā saṃvegabhayena mānasaṃ saṃvejetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.8:6.3: Idaṃ mahārāja suriyassa chaṭṭhaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.8:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja suriyo kalyāṇapāpake dasseti,
mil7.4.8:7.2: evameva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena indriyabala-bojjhanga-satipaṭṭhāna-sammappadhāna-iddhipāda-lokiyalokuttaradhammā dassetabbā.
mil7.4.8:7.3: Idaṃ mahārāja suriyassa sattamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
